text: A drill/driver spins to make holes and drive screws.
Pick the right bit for the job.
Clamp your board before drilling. Never hold it in your hand.

tip.text: Keep both hands on the drill and your fingers behind the tip.

text: Start slow. Push straight in, and let the bit do the cutting.
Back the bit out with the drill still spinning.
To drive screws, use the clutch so screws do not go in too deep.

tip.text: Try it on a scrap piece first.
